Name: Growing Children
Author: GustavoHenriqueRS
Description:
[size=6][b]Growing Children[/b][/size]

In Stardew your kids stay toddlers forever, and that always bugged me. So I made this mod to let them actually grow up.

Once a kid is old enough they become a young adult. They take after both parents (hair, skin, eyes, clothes) and pick a job: farmer, rancher, fisher, forager or miner. And they actually do the work — whatever they gather goes into their own backpack, and you just talk to them to collect it. Every morning you get a short summary of what everyone brought in.

Works in single-player and co-op, and it's fully removable: one console command, sleep a night, delete the folder, and you're back to vanilla.

[center][b]Enjoying the mod? You can support its development:[/b]
[url=https://buymeacoffee.com/gustavohenn][img]https://cdn.buymeacoffee.com/buttons/v2/default-yellow.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://buymeacoffee.com/gustavohenn]buymeacoffee.com/gustavohenn[/url][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]What each kid does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Farmer[/b] — plants, waters and harvests crops in the field areas you mark for them.[/*]
[*][b]Rancher[/b] — takes care of the barn and coop animals, then picks up truffles around the farm.[/*]
[*][b]Fisher[/b] — walks to a fishing spot and fishes through the day. A better rod means better catches.[/*]
[*][b]Forager[/b] — gathers forage, chops twigs into wood and clears weeds into fiber.[/*]
[*][b]Miner[/b] — heads down the mine, breaks rocks for ore and geodes, and handles the odd monster.[/*]
[/list]They get better the more they work, so what they bring home improves over time. Jobs are handed out so you ideally end up with one of each, and you can change one with a console command.

[size=5][b]Other things it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Growing up is a little moment: a line using the kid's own portrait, a chime, and the reveal of the job they picked.[/*]
[*]You can put hats and clothes on them.[/*]
[*]The child limit goes from 2 to 5 (you can change it) so you can raise one of each job. Pregnancy chances stay vanilla; only the cap changes.[/*]
[*]They walk around, chat, and siblings even trade a few lines with each other.[/*]
[*]In co-op the host runs everything and it syncs to the other players. Each player gets the report for their own kids.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Interacting with a grown kid[/b][/size]
Click one to open a small menu: talk, open their backpack, send them to work, mark a field (farmers), pick a fishing spot (fishers), or give them a hat. You can also just hold a hat, shirt or pants and click them to put it on.

[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]
Edit config.json after the first run:
[list]
[*][b]DaysAsToddlerBeforeAdult[/b] (14) — toddler days before they can grow up.[/*]
[*][b]AutoGrowUp[/b] (true) — grow the same day with the scene, or show a "ready" notice and grow the next morning.[/*]
[*][b]MaxChildren[/b] (5) — kids per couple. 2 is vanilla.[/*]
[*][b]DebugLogging[/b] (false) — extra console logs.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Needs SMAPI on Stardew Valley 1.6+. No hard dependencies. Plays fine with Stardew Valley Expanded, Immersive Family, Extra Large Farm, Farm Type Manager and others. In co-op everyone needs it installed.

[size=5][b]Install & uninstall[/b][/size]
Install SMAPI, unzip this into your Mods folder, and run the game. To remove it cleanly: run gc_uninstall in the SMAPI console, sleep one night, then delete the folder — everything goes back to vanilla.

[size=5][b]Languages[/b][/size]
English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Simplified Chinese and Russian. Translations live in the i18n folder — copy default.json, translate the values, and SMAPI picks it up. Corrections and new languages are very welcome.

[i]It's my first mod and I've been testing it for a while. If something breaks, send me a SMAPI log and I'll sort it out. If you're enjoying it, an endorsement really helps.[/i]

[size=5][b]Português[/b][/size]
Seus filhos ficam bebês pra sempre no Stardew, e isso sempre me incomodou — então fiz este mod pra eles crescerem de verdade. Quando ficam grandes, viram jovens adultos, puxam os dois pais (cabelo, pele, olhos, roupa) e escolhem uma profissão (fazendeiro, pecuarista, pescador, coletor ou mineiro) que ajuda de verdade na fazenda. Tudo que juntam vai pra mochila deles; é só conversar pra pegar. Toda manhã tem um resumo do que cada um trouxe. Tem cena de maioridade, chapéus/roupas, limite de filhos maior (2 → 5) e funciona no co-op. É reversível: rode gc_uninstall, durma e apague a pasta pra voltar ao vanilla. Idiomas: inglês, português, espanhol, francês, alemão, chinês e russo.
